title: Four generations and her grandfather the cornetist
summary: A photo of four generations; her grandfather played cornet, his mother guitar, and he lived mostly in Newark.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

Well, this is my grandfather, right? That's his father right here.
And he played, too, you see? He played music?
